text: On hujja arɗo ka Daalol Allah : (Ko honnde e feddeeji ɗin ɗiɗi ɓuri hanndude e deeƴere?) mo Ibraahiima foolirnoo yimɓe mun ɓen, ko hujja Amen mo Men Yeɗi mo e dow yimɓe makko ɓen. Meɗen Ɓamtira darja on mo Men Muuyi e jeyaaɓe Amen ɓen aduna e laakara. Pellet, Joomi maaɗa an Nulaaɗo, ko Ñeeño e tagu Makko ngun e toppitagol Mo ngol, Annduɗo jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen.
